segments.ja467:1.1: Kāmaṃ kāmayamānassa, tassa ce taṃ samijjhati;
segments.ja467:1.3: Addhā pītimano hoti, laddhā macco yadicchati.
segments.ja467:2.1: Kāmaṃ kāmayamānassa, tassa ce taṃ samijjhati;
segments.ja467:2.3: Tato naṃ aparaṃ kāme, dhamme taṇhaṃva vindati.
segments.ja467:3.5: Bhiyyo taṇhā pipāsā ca, vaḍḍhamānassa vaḍḍhati.
segments.ja467:4.1: Pathabyā sāliyavakaṃ, gavassaṃ [gavāsaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] dāsaporisaṃ;
segments.ja467:4.3: Datvā ca [datvāpi (sī. syā.), datvā vā (pī.)] nālamekassa, iti vidvā [viddhā (syā.)] samaṃ care.
segments.ja467:5.1: Rājā pasayha pathaviṃ vijitvā, sasāgarantaṃ mahimāvasanto;
segments.ja467:5.3: Oraṃ samuddassa atittarūpo [atittirūpo (ka.)], pāraṃ samuddassapi patthayetha.
segments.ja467:6.1: Yāva anussaraṃ kāme, manasā titti nājjhagā;
segments.ja467:6.3: Tato nivattā paṭikamma disvā, te ve sutittā ye [tittā (sī. syā. pī.)] paññāya tittā.
segments.ja467:7.1: Paññāya tittinaṃ [tittīnaṃ (sī. syā.)] seṭṭhaṃ, na so kāmehi tappati;
segments.ja467:7.3: Paññāya tittaṃ purisaṃ, taṇhā na kurute vasaṃ.
segments.ja467:8.1: Apacinetheva kāmānaṃ [kāmāni (sī. syā. pī.)], appicchassa alolupo;
segments.ja467:8.3: Samuddamatto puriso, na so kāmehi tappati.
segments.ja467:9.3: Yaṃ yaṃ cajati [jahati (syā. ka.)] kāmānaṃ, taṃ taṃ sampajjate sukhaṃ;
segments.ja467:9.5: Sabbaṃ ce sukhamiccheyya, sabbe kāme pariccaje.
segments.ja467:10.1: Aṭṭha te bhāsitā gāthā, sabbā honti sahassiyo [sahassiyā (?) upari sutasomajātake tathā dissati];
segments.ja467:11.1: Na me attho sahassehi, satehi nahutehi vā;
segments.ja467:11.3: Pacchimaṃ bhāsato gāthaṃ, kāme me na rato mano.
segments.ja467:12.3: Yo imaṃ taṇhaṃ [yo taṇhaṃ (sī. syā.)] dukkhajananiṃ, parijānāti paṇḍitoti.
